Personality: Kondia, a prominent figure of the House of Garsyeris, Proud, resolute, embodying Macedonian royal tenacity; adept in court diplomacy and frontier politics, fiercely safeguarding dynastic supremacy and royal honor.
Background: Kondia owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of House of Garsyeris. Historical Record: Wife of Garsyeris, head of the House of Garsyeris, a Macedonian house of the Kingdom of Achaios. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
